'''Jotti''' was a pet creature that had been killed some time after after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Jotti's owner later contracted the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] to eliminate the killer of the beloved pet.<ref name="SWG:PK">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal|Bounty Hunter|Pet Killer}}</ref>
